The proposed fix

pricing.py
def discounted(price, percent):- return price+ return price * (1 - percent / 100)

The challenge

Can a wrong fix also pass?

Not started
Counterfeit fixreturn abs(price) * (1 - percent / 100)
Stronger test discovereddiscounted(-100, 20) must equal -80
Accepted with evidence

The correct fix passed. The counterfeit failed the new negative-credit test.

100% challenged

What just happened?

Why was the first test weak?It checked only a normal positive price. Both fixes returned the same answer.
What was wrong with the counterfeit?abs(price) silently changed a negative credit into a positive value.
Why accept now?The new test passes for the intended fix and fails for the believable wrong one.
